checks.claim: The recipient opens the invitation email and clicks its Leave a testimonial button.
Submitting through a Senja form does not require an account or special software.
The student can record directly in the form or upload a video.
The student must answer every displayed question and provide their name; other About you fields depend on the form configuration.
The consent page is enabled by default and lets the student choose public or private use.
Completing the submission requires reaching the Submit button at the end of the form.

context_review: Full four official pages read; account/software statement concerns respondents, not account owners. Form count disagreement also found and sent to normal recompilation, not manually resolved.
